annotation.title_clean: Council Regulation (EU) 2024/1732 amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 as regards a EuroHPC initiative for start-ups in order to boost European leadership in trustworthy artificial intelligence
annotation.title_en: Council Regulation (EU) 2024/1732 amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 as regards a EuroHPC initiative for start-ups in order to boost European leadership in trustworthy artificial intelligence
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Council Regulation amending the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking regulation to add a seventh objective: acquiring AI-optimised supercomputers and establishing 'AI factories' to give start-ups and researchers access to computing for training trustworthy general-purpose AI. Robotics and automated driving are mentioned only as strategic application areas.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines 'AI-optimised supercomputer' and 'AI factory' and adds an AI factory pillar to EuroHPC.
Union funds up to 50% of acquisition and operating costs of AI-optimised supercomputers.
Access limited to proposals for trustworthy and ethical AI in line with Union values, with dedicated access for start-ups and SMEs.
Existing hosting entities can become AI factories via a fair, transparent selection by the Governing Board.
Supplier selection must address supply-chain security; participation may be restricted for security reasons.
